│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃                             other Makefiles                              ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ include $(ROOTDIR)/Makefile.config_if_required                               │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃        %(DEPDIR) must be kept in sync with entries in .gitignore         ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ DEPDIR=.dep D=d MKDIR=mkdir -p                                               │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃   $(EMPTY) is defined in Makefile.config, but may not have been loaded   ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ EMPTY :=                                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃                     $(SPACE) contains a single space                     ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ SPACE := $(EMPTY) $(EMPTY)                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃    $( ) suppresses warning from the alignments in the V_ macros below    ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ $(SPACE) :=                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ ifeq "$(UNIX_OR_WIN32)" "win32" DIR_SEP := $ # There must a space following  │
│ the $ CONVERT_PATH = $(subst /,$(DIR_SEP),$(strip $(1))) else DIR_SEP = /    │
│ CONVERT_PATH = $(strip $(1)) endif                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ V ?= 0                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│ ifeq "$(V)" "0"                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ V_CC         = @$(info $   CC $@) V_CCDEPS     = @$(info $   CCDEPS $@)      │
│ V_OCAMLC     = @$(info $   OCAMLC $@) V_OCAMLOPT   = @$(info $   OCAMLOPT    │
│ $@) V_GEN        = @$(info $   GEN $@) V_LINKC      = @$(info $   LINKC $@)  │
│ V_LINKOPT    = @$(info $   LINKOPT $@) V_MKEXE      = @$(info $   MKEXE $@)  │
│ V_MKLIB      = @$(info $   MKLIB $@) V_MKDLL      = @$(info $   MKDLL $@)    │
│ V_OCAMLLEX   = @$(info $   OCAMLLEX $@) V_OCAMLYACC  = @$(info $   OCAMLYACC │
│ $@) V_OCAMLDEP   = @$(info $   OCAMLDEP $@) V_ASM        = @$(info $   ASM   │
│ $@) V_OCAMLMKLIB = @$(info $   OCAMLMKLIB $@) V_OCAMLDOC   = @$(info $       │
│ OCAMLDOC $@) V_ODOC       = @$(info $   ODOC $@)                             │
│                                                                              │
│ else                                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ V_CC         = V_CCDEPS     = V_OCAMLC     = V_OCAMLOPT   = V_GEN        =   │
│ V_LINKC      = V_LINKOPT    = V_MKEXE      = V_MKLIB      = V_MKDLL      =   │
│ V_OCAMLLEX   = V_OCAMLYACC  = V_OCAMLDEP   = V_ASM        = V_OCAMLMKLIB =   │
│ V_OCAMLDOC   = V_ODOC       =                                                │
│                                                                              │
│ endif                                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ DESTDIR ?= INSTALL_BINDIR := $(DESTDIR)$(BINDIR) INSTALL_LIBDIR :=           │
│ $(DESTDIR)$(LIBDIR) INSTALL_INCDIR=$(INSTALL_LIBDIR)/caml INSTALL_STUBLIBDIR │
│ := $(DESTDIR)$(STUBLIBDIR) INSTALL_LIBDIR_PROFILING =                        │
│ $(INSTALL_LIBDIR)/profiling INSTALL_MANDIR := $(DESTDIR)$(MANDIR)            │
│ INSTALL_PROGRAMS_MAN_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(PROGRAMS_MAN_DIR)                    │
│ INSTALL_LIBRARIES_MAN_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(LIBRARIES_MAN_DIR) INSTALL_DOCDIR   │
│ := $(DESTDIR)$(DOCDIR)                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│ FLEXDLL_SUBMODULE_PRESENT := $(wildcard $(ROOTDIR)/flexdll/Makefile)         │
│                                                                              │
│ IN_COREBOOT_CYCLE ?= false                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃           Variables used to represent the OCaml runtime system           ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃    Most of the time, boot/ocamlrun and runtime/ocamlrun are the same.    ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃     However, under some circumstances it is important to be able to      ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃        distinguish one from the other, hence these two variables.        ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃    Boot/ocamlrun is the most frequently used in the build system, so     ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃      we use OCAMLRUN to designate it and keep NEW_OCAMLRUN to refer      ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃         to runtime/ocamlrun, because it's less frequently used.          ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ OCAMLRUN ?= $(ROOTDIR)/boot/ocamlrun$(EXE) NEW_OCAMLRUN ?=                   │
│ $(ROOTDIR)/runtime/ocamlrun$(EXE)                                            │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃                          Standard library flags                          ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ STDLIBFLAGS ?= -nostdlib -I $(ROOTDIR)/stdlib BOOT_STDLIBFLAGS ?= -nostdlib  │
│ -I $(ROOTDIR)/boot                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ TEST_BOOT_OCAMLC_OPT = $(shell                                               │
│ test $(ROOTDIR)/boot/ocamlc.opt -nt $(ROOTDIR)/boot/ocamlc;                  │
│ echo $$?)                                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃                     Use boot/ocamlc.opt if available                     ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ifeq "$(TEST_BOOT_OCAMLC_OPT)" "0" BOOT_OCAMLC = $(ROOTDIR)/boot/ocamlc.opt  │
│ else BOOT_OCAMLC = $(OCAMLRUN) $(ROOTDIR)/boot/ocamlc endif                  │
│                                                                              │
│ BOOT_OCAMLDEP = $(BOOT_OCAMLC) -depend                                       │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃    Takes an implicit path and converts it to a path expression which     ┃ │
│ ┃                                returns to                                ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃ the current directory. e.g. $(call ROOT_FROM, foo/bar/) expands to ../.. ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ REMOVE_SLASH = $(strip $(patsubst %/,%, $(1))) ROOT_FROM =                   │
│ $(subst $(SPACE),/,$(patsubst %,..,$(subst /, ,$(call REMOVE_SLASH, $(1))))) │
│                                                                              │
│ BYTE_BUILD_TREE = byte OPT_BUILD_TREE = opt                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ BYTE_BINDIR = $(BYTE_BUILD_TREE)/bin OPT_BINDIR = $(OPT_BUILD_TREE)/bin      │
│                                                                              │
│ ifeq "$(BOOTSTRAPPING_FLEXDLL)" "true" override REAL_ROOT_DIR := $(realpath  │
│ $(ROOTDIR)) ifeq "$(filter $(REAL_ROOT_DIR)/$(BYTE_BINDIR), $(subst :,       │
│ ,$(PATH)))" "" export PATH :=                                                │
│ $(REAL_ROOT_DIR)/$(OPT_BINDIR):$(REAL_ROOT_DIR)/$(BYTE_BINDIR):$(PATH)       │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃    $(BUILD_COMPANY_SYSTEM) is the last two parts of $(BUILD_TRIPLET)     ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ BUILD_TRIPLET_FIELDS := $(subst -,$(SPACE),$(BUILD_TRIPLET))                 │
│ BUILD_COMPANY_SYSTEM := $(subst $(SPACE),-,$                                 │

│ Findings (likely causes)                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│  • If the "run-length compressing free space" change altered any of these:   │
│     • The tag used to mark free blocks (No_scan_tag),                        │
│     • The color used (NOT_MARKABLE),                                         │
│     • The meaning of the wosize field (off-by-one or reversed),              │
│     • The presence/position/semantics of the second word freelist pointer    │
│       (p[1]), then a large number of places in shared_heap.c and other GC    │
│       code will misinterpret headers and crash the bootstrapping compiler.   │
│  • The codebase relies heavily on the exact header layout (Make_header,      │
│    Wosize_* macros, Tag_hd/Color_hd). Any change that uses reserved header   │
│    bits or reinterprets header fields without updating all code paths will   │
│    break the system.                                                         │
│  • From inspection, the code in shared_heap.c implements the standard        │
│    semantics; I did not find an obvious bug in the committed code here —     │
│    which suggests the user’s changes likely modified how free runs are       │
│    encoded or the header macros themselves (Make_header/Macros in mlvalues.h │
│    or gc.h) rather than a subtle bug in pool_sweep.                          │
│                                                                              │
│ Why I could not finish the requested validation here                         │
│                                                                              │
│  • Running make/tests requires a full configure + build of the compiler      │

│  • }                                                                         │
│  • next[1] = p[1]; } else { next = (value*)p[1]; } @@ CAMLassert( /* either  │
│    there's no more free space and we've moved the pool / (r->next_obj == 0   │
│    && local->full_pools[sz] == r) / or there's still free space */ ||        │

│                                                                              │
│ Notes about the patch                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│  • It prints rich diagnostics and a backtrace when a suspicious              │
│    header/wosize/freelist pointer is found.                                  │
│  • It aborts after printing, to ensure you capture the exact failing state.  │
│  • The diagnostics rely on execinfo.h backtrace() (typical on Linux). If     │
│    your system lacks execinfo, the backtrace calls will be guarded by the    │
│    HAVE_EXECINFO macro — most configure runs define HAVE_EXECINFO; if you    │
│    don't have it, backtrace printing will be skipped but the header dump     │
│    will still appear.                                                        │
│  • The macro DUMP_BAD_FREE is used to centralize printing.                   │
│                                                                              │
│ How to use the patch and collect logs (recommended steps)                    │
│                                                                              │
│  1 Save and apply the patch:                                                 │
│     • From repo root: git apply dbg_shared_heap.patch OR patch -p1 <         │
│       dbg_shared_heap.patch                                                  │
│  2 Reconfigure and rebuild the compiler/runtime (enable debug if helpful):   │
│    ./configure --enable-ocamltest make -jN                                   │
│    Notes:                                                                    │
│     • --enable-ocamltest ensures ocamltest is built and the testsuite can    │
│       run.                                                                   │
│     • If you want more assertions and debug checks enabled, add configure    │
│       flags that enable DEBUG/instrumented runtime for your build; see       │
│       INSTALL.adoc/HACKING.adoc.                                             │
│  3 Run the failing tests: make -C testsuite one DIR=tests/basic              │
│  4 If the runtime hits a malformed free header, you will see stderr lines    │
│    like: BAD FREE DETECTED: freelist p[1] points outside pool pool=0x...     │
│    sz=... wh=... start=... end=... p=... hd=0x... tag=... color=0x...        │
│    wosize=... p1=0x... BACKTRACE (most recent first): <function frames>      │
│    Copy the entire stderr output (the BAD FREE dump and backtrace) and paste │
│    it here.                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ What I'll do with the diagnostic output once you share it                    │
│                                                                              │
│  • I will analyze the exact values printed:                                  │
│     • header hd bits, Tag_hd(hd), Color_hd(hd), Wosize_hd(hd), and the p[1]  │
│       value.                                                                 │
│  • From those bits we can determine what invariant was violated:             │
│     • If Tag_hd != No_scan_tag or Color_hd != NOT_MARKABLE, free blocks are  │
│       no longer encoded as the rest of the runtime expects.                  │
│     • If Wosize_hd encodes an unexpected number (off-by-one or encoded       │
│       differently), that indicates the compression changed interpretation of │
│       Wosize.                                                                │
│     • If p[1] is not a pointer into the pool or a free-block pointer, the    │
│       freelist layout has changed.                                           │
│  • I will produce a minimal patch to restore the appropriate representation  │
│    or else adapt all the code paths to the new representation — whichever is │
│    the minimal correct fix consistent with the rest of the runtime.          │
│  • I will then give exact commands to rebuild and re-run make -C testsuite   │
│    one DIR=tests/basic to confirm the basic testsuite passes.                │
│                                                                              │
│ Why this targets the real problem                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  • All evidence from the code review shows the allocator and                 │
│    sweep/compaction code rely on a very specific free-block layout:          │
│     • POOL_FREE_HEADER(wosize) is Make_header(wosize, No_scan_tag,           │
│       NOT_MARKABLE).                                                         │
│     • The run-length semantics used are "the header's wosize encodes the     │
│       number of contiguous free blocks that follow the header", so the total │
│       contiguous run length = 1 + Wosize_hd(hd).                             │
│     • The second word (offset 1) of a free block holds the freelist "next    │
│       pointer".                                                              │
│  • Your "run-length compression" changes likely altered either the header    │
│    field meaning, tag/color usage, or second word freelist pointer           │
│    placement. The instrumentation will reveal which.                         │
│                                                                              │

│    now store total run length or store bytes instead of words, that will     │
│    show up as an inconsistent numeric value; I'll map it to POOL_WSIZE/wh to │
│    decide.                                                                   │

│    outside the pool or is not a free-block pointer, allocation/sweep will    │
